text:
alex_sales: Starting a thread for TerraForge POC. Customer wants us to validate our runtime against a custom TerraForge-34B-slim variant and get a cost + SLA recommendation. They attached a security questionnaire and said EU-only data residency. Anyone able to jump in? :eyes:

mira_eng_ml: I can take compatibility. Important: do they require persistent KV cache (prefix caching) and attention KV layout compatibility? TerraForge forks sometimes reorder KV dims.

alex_sales: They said persistent KV + per-tenant cache. Latency target: 150ms p95 for 512-token responses. Preference is q8_0 but will accept q4_0 if accuracy drop is >2% on their eval set.

omri_platform: Ops questions: will logs include source data? If yes, that impacts KMS and retention. Also need to confirm whether they'll accept our EU region (eu-west-1) Dedicated cluster or need on-prem.

sam_solutions: Can you post the questionnaire? Ill run an onboarding runbook and estimate eng hours. We have a checklist for tokenizer adapters, custom RMSNorm, rotary vs sin/cos embeddings.

alex_sales: Questionnaire: https://files.company/terraforge/poc-sec-2026.pdf Also customer said they can provide HF id or a model tarball.

mira_eng_ml: If they provide tarball I'll run the analyzer. Sending them this command helps: 
```
./tools/inspect_model --input terraforge-34b.tar.gz --json
```
It reports tokenizer files, config (rmsnorm, rotary), kv_shape, input_embedding_type. If they can't share tarball, request HF id + config.json + tokenizer files.

omri_platform: KMS: For Private we require customer KMS or our ephemeral escrow flow. Dedicated supports BYOK with ACL. For hosted we only support managed keys unless account has enterprise KMS add-on. Need sec signoff for rotation policy.

sam_solutions: Action list I propose: 1) Mira to run analyzer (or provide command to customer). 2) Alex to collect questionnaire answers + HF id/tarball. 3) Jen to prepare a cost comparison slide (Hosted vs Dedicated w/ 3-mo POC and 12-mo commit). 4) Omri to confirm EU deployment + KMS path.

mira_eng_ml: ETA: I can do a scan within 24h after we get the tarball. If tokenizer is non-standard we may need a 2-3 day adapter. Also callout: if KV layout is dense-quantized (int8 packed) we might need a conversion step for our runtime.

jen_sales_ops: Pricing notes: quick back-of-envelope: Hosted q8_0 ~ $X/token (payg). Dedicated reserved gives ~35% unit savings at stable QPS for 34B. I'll fill actual numbers after Mira confirms batch size and throughput assumptions.

secbot: SECURITY BOT: Questionnaire flagged items: Q3 (data residency), Q8 (KMS rotation & key custody), Q15 (PII in logs). Security team please review and reply within 48h. :lock:

omri_platform: Also confirm SLA: 99.9% is achievable on Dedicated in eu-west-1. Hosted may require enterprise plan and cross-zone redundancy. We'll include fallback plan to another compatible 34B variant in case of degradation.

alex_sales: Customer also asked about time to onboard a new variant. Whats realistic now?

mira_eng_ml: If they provide compatible tokenizer + standard config: ~1-2 business days to validate and run perf tests. If tokenizer adapter or custom RMSNorm conversion required: 3-8 business days depending on fixes.

sam_solutions: I'll attach our adapter-runbook and a template for questionnaire answers once Alex collects initial responses.

alex_sales: Great. I'll ping customer for tarball + questionnaire answers and request KV layout doc. Will update here after reply. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
